items.claim: CFO 預估 2026 全年同店營收成長落在 30% 中後段到 30% 高段
items.quote: full year increase that is in the mid- to high 30% range
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: CFO 表示毛利率可能維持近幾季的高檔區間
items.quote: gross profit margins are likely to continue
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: CFO 預期全年有效稅率約 23%
items.quote: We expect our full year effective tax rate to be around 23%.
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 全年資本支出約占營收 5%
items.quote: CapEx expenditures will be approximately 5% of our revenue
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 管理層點出下半年（尤其第四季）比較基期很重
items.quote: some really, really heavy comparables coming up
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: CFO 說明財測是由現場人力負載由下而上建構
items.quote: We build it from the bottom up, Julio.
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.claim: CFO 稱本季現金流除預收款外，沒有單一特殊項目
items.quote: there's no unique item to point out
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 剔除上季單次性利得後，Q2 毛利率較 Q1 上升
items.quote: absent the unique gains that we identified and quantified
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 機械部門毛利率升至 25.6%（去年同期 22.9%）
items.quote: Mechanical segment jumped to 25.6%
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: SG&A 占營收比由 9.7% 降至 8.8%
items.quote: declined from 9.7% of revenue last year to 8.8% this
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: CFO 稱專案估計變動的淨利得每年皆有，但本季較平常大
items.quote: They're bigger this quarter than usual.
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: CFO 稱 2005 年起專案每年都有淨利得
items.quote: net gain in our jobs every single year ever
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: Q1 單次性利得口徑：4,300 萬美元超出一般利得範圍
items.quote: we identified $43 million of gains that
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 模組化投資報酬被形容為一年到兩年回收
items.quote: the returns are embarrassing
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 自由現金流約三分之一來自預收款，其餘為良好績效
items.quote: might be the advanced cash that we've gotten in the past
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 季股息調升 0.10 美元至 0.90 美元
items.quote: quarterly dividend by $0.10 to $0.90 per share
items.speaker: CEO Brian Lane

items.claim: CFO 表示對自家股票評價看法空前正面，今年上半年買回較去年慢
items.quote: We like our stock better than we've ever liked it.
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 新收購 Hunt Electric 預計年化營收約 2.5 億美元
items.quote: contribute about $250 million of annualized revenue
items.speaker: CEO Brian Lane

items.claim: 近期傾向買下廠房而非租賃
items.quote: We've been tending towards ownership lately
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 科技類占上半年營收 58%（去年 40%）
items.quote: was 58% of our revenue, a substantial increase from 40%
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.claim: 期末在手訂單創新高 141 億美元
items.quote: was a record $14.1 billion
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.claim: 進入第三季時同店在手訂單較去年高 69%
items.quote: same-store backlog 69% higher than at this time last year
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.claim: 模組化本季新增訂單 5.1 億美元，超過消耗量
items.quote: Modular had bookings of $510 million.
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 管理層稱建築類在手訂單多數在 18 至 24 個月內消耗
items.quote: burns on the construction side in the next 18 to 24
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 與前沿實驗室及主機代管商有小型試點合約，尚屬早期
items.quote: some success with some pilot contracts
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.claim: 與兩家超大規模客戶持續取得量的承諾，並以此支撐擴產
items.quote: willing to continue to provide us volume commitments
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.claim: 模組化產能預計 2027 夏末達約 500 萬平方呎
items.quote: 5 million square feet of capacity by late summer 2027

items.claim: 資料中心服務商機屬長期，目前受 OEM 保固期影響
items.quote: it's not an immediate opportunity
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.quote: customers provide us meaningful multiyear commitments
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.claim: CEO 稱只接確定能執行的工作
items.quote: we only take work that we know we can perform
items.speaker: CEO Brian Lane

items.claim: CFO 稱客戶扶植其他模組化廠商是因需求超過 FIX 產能，並非取代
items.quote: our customers are not inducing other people to build this to
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 被問資料中心輿論轉向時，CFO 稱客戶無放緩跡象
items.quote: so we see no letdown whatsoever
items.speaker: CFO Bill George

items.claim: 被問州級暫停令，稱在手訂單多已規劃並取得許可
items.quote: was already planned, permitted through
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

items.claim: 對資料中心輿論阻力的立場：終究會被蓋，地點可能改變
items.quote: data centers as many as can be built are going to get built
items.speaker: President Trent McKenna

qa_flags.question: Goldman 問 10-Q 顯示估計變動對 Q2 營收貢獻約 7.7%、底層毛利率該如何看
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給底層毛利率數字，改談 2005 年以來歷史與 Q1 的 4,300 萬美元利得口徑；僅承認本季利得較平常大

qa_flags.question: Sidoti 問下半年隱含同店成長約 20% 後段至 30% 出頭，是否可作為 2027 起跑點
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未回答 2027 退出速率，改談財測由下而上編製與第四季比較基期偏重

qa_flags.question: Goldman 問模組化每新增 100 萬平方呎的資本支出
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給單位資本支出，重申占營收 5% 的指引並稱租購之間仍有彈性

qa_flags.question: Oppenheimer 問超額計費（billings in excess）大幅變動是否來自單一模組化客戶
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未指明是否單一客戶，答為各項現金流因素的總和與客戶信任度
